dataset_notice: Synthetic starter dataset generated for BijliBuddy MVP demonstration and evaluation. Not real customer production data.
limitations: Trained on an explicitly synthetic starter dataset calibrated to typical Delhi household service rates.
Excludes physical hardware/spare part costs (e.g., new copper wiring coils, MCB units, ceiling fans, or inverter batteries).

Always distinct from the electrician's final on-site quotation.
